nodes.description: IP addresses (or hostnames) of cluster nodes, one per line.

public_addresses_file.description: Path to file containing public (virtual) IP addresses for clients.

base_path.description: Directory where CTDB stores persistent state, databases, and event scripts.

lock_file.description: Path to lock file for shared storage coordination (e.g., for GFS2/NFS).

recovery_lock_file.description: Path to lock file used during recovery operations to prevent split-brain.

recovery_grace_period.description: Seconds to wait before starting recovery after a node joins or rejoins.

recovery_blackout_period.description: Seconds after which a misbehaving node will be forcibly fenced (set to 0 to disable).

ip_allocation_method.description: Method for assigning public IPs: 'dhcp', 'static', or 'random'. Note: 'dhcp' is *not* recommended per CTDB docs — 'static' or 'none' are preferred for production.

ip_allocations.description: Static public IP assignments (only used if ip_allocation_method = 'static').

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logs (e.g., 'DEBUG' for troubleshooting, 'WARNING' for production).

log_subsystems.description: CTDB subsystems to log. Use 'all' or comma-separated names like 'lcp','notify'.

log_file_path.description: Path to main CTDB log file. Official default: /var/log/ctdb/log.ctdb (not /var/log/ctdb/ctdb.log).

event_scripts_max.description: Max concurrent event script invocations. Increase for large clusters with complex HA scripts.

client_connect_limit.description: Max simultaneous client TCP connections per CTDB node.

client_timeout.description: Seconds before a client call is considered failed (increase for slow backends).

event_scripts_enable.description: Enable built-in event scripting engine (required for HA, failover, etc.).

event_script_dirs.description: Additional directories containing custom event scripts.

node_hints.description: Optional hints to influence node preferability during failover (priority: higher = more preferred).
